title: Club teams no longer show national flags
items: Fixed club competitions (Ligue 1, EPL, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, UCL) picking up a country flag whenever a team's short code happened to collide with an ISO country code -- e.g. Marseille's OM code was rendering Oman's flag.
Flags are now shown only for genuine national-team competitions (World Cup); club fixtures, standings, brackets, and modals no longer attempt a flag lookup.
